nodes.g: The tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet
nodes.klein: The tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet. Its name ‘Yodh’, ‘Yod’, is related to יָד (= hand); so called in allusion to the ancient Hebrew form of this letter. In PBH it has the numerical value ten. Alternates sometimes with א (see the introductory article to letter א).
